Positive: ff02::5 and ff02::6 share one SPI and each (group, SPI) lookup returns that group's own SA, i.e. step 2 (SPI + destination) of the section 4.1 search resolves an Any-Source Multicast group SA. Step 1 (SPI+dst+src) is vacuous: Ze builds no source-specific multicast SA. Caveat recorded, not a finding against the tests: the ff02::1 case rests on Linux identifying the fe80:: unicast SA by (dst, SPI, proto) rather than the section 4.1 SPI(+protocol) identifier, so a literal step 3 would match that unicast SA; the stray-SPI case alone carries the negative without that reading.
